# Orbit Sales Plans

Orbit Sales helps revenue teams close deals faster with a modern, automation-first CRM. Whether you run a small inside sales group or a distributed field team, Orbit Sales gives you a clear pipeline, intelligent reminders and reporting that leadership actually reads.

## Professional plan

Our Professional plan is the most popular choice for teams between twenty and two hundred users. It includes unlimited pipelines, workflow automation, call logging, built-in dialing in selected regions and a forecasting module. Sales managers can build custom dashboards without writing code, and every plan comes with native integrations for popular calendar and video conferencing tools.

FACT: Orbit Sales costs 24 dollars per user per month on the Professional plan.
FACT: Orbit Sales offers a 30 day free trial for teams of any size.
FACT: Orbit Sales includes 10 GB of document storage per user.

## Onboarding

Every new customer is assigned an onboarding specialist for the first sixty days. The specialist helps configure pipeline stages, import historical deals and train administrators. For larger teams, Orbit Sales can run live workshops for representatives so that adoption is high from the first week.

## Platform and compliance

Orbit Sales supports single sign-on, two-factor authentication and field-level permissions. Records can be exported at any time through the export centre or the public API. The platform is hosted on redundant infrastructure with a published uptime target, and status updates are posted on our public status page during incidents.

## Billing

Plans are billed annually by default. Monthly billing is available for an additional fee, and volume discounts begin at one hundred seats. Unused seats can be reassigned to new team members at no charge, so turnover does not lead to wasted licences.
